bootstrap.rule: Detect first, preserve existing architecture, persist only non-secret project metadata, and never reinstall a valid configured project without a reason.

selfCheck.rule: Run both after changing kit files, templates, manifest contracts, or bootstrap scripts; both must report ok: true. The repository-local Lefthook pre-commit guard runs both automatically once enabled with `npx lefthook install`.

skills.portable: Every pack follows the open Agent Skills format, so the same directory can be copied into any harness skills directory without rewriting it.

packs.activation: Load only for user-facing UI/UX work; read SKILL.md, then open only the reference files the task maps to.
packs.summary: User-facing pages, flows, component systems, responsive behavior, and visual QA.
packs.summaryTh: งาน UI ที่ผู้ใช้เห็น: หน้า, flow, ระบบคอมโพเนนต์, responsive และ visual QA

packs.activation: Load only for endpoint, route-handler, request/response contract, or API test work; read SKILL.md, then open only the reference files the task maps to.
packs.summary: HTTP endpoints and route handlers, request/response contracts, error shapes, authorization boundaries, and API tests.
packs.summaryTh: งาน HTTP endpoint/route handler, สัญญา request/response, error shape, ขอบเขต authz และ API test

packs.activation: Load only for schema, migration, query, or data-access work; read SKILL.md, then open only the reference files the task maps to.
packs.summary: Schema and constraint design, migration safety and rollback, query and index work, tenant scoping, data verification.
packs.summaryTh: งาน schema/constraint, ความปลอดภัยของ migration, query และ index, tenant scoping, การตรวจข้อมูล

packs.activation: Load only when choosing what to verify, adding or repairing tests, fixing a bug that must not return, or deciding what CI gates; read SKILL.md, then open only the reference files the task maps to.
packs.summary: Choosing what to verify, test levels, browser journeys, flakiness and test data, regression tests.
packs.summaryTh: การเลือกสิ่งที่จะตรวจสอบ, ระดับของ test, browser journey, flakiness และ test data, regression test

packs.activation: Load only for release work; read SKILL.md, then open only the reference files the task maps to.
packs.summary: Planning and executing a production release safely: preflight verification, deploy execution, rollback readiness, release observability, and post-release confirmation.
packs.summaryTh: การวางแผนและ execute release อย่างปลอดภัย: preflight, deploy, rollback, observability หลัง release และการยืนยันหลังปล่อยจริง

policy.packageManagerRule: Use the package manager selected by the existing lockfile.
policy.stackRule: Detect and preserve the existing architecture. Do not force Supabase, Neon, Drizzle, Prisma, Vercel, or any other provider merely because it appears in this kit.

rules: expand context only when a dependency requires it
do not reread unchanged files without a reason
use Repomix only for architecture-wide or genuinely broad tasks

tools.probeNote: requires Python 3.10+ in an isolated environment

tools.installScope: HTTP API; no local installation required
tools.probeNote: nothing to install locally; verified by calling the API with a credential
depends on the observability stack each project selects

databaseOptions.when: Managed PostgreSQL is needed without Supabase platform features
Postgres plus Auth, Storage, Realtime, or Supabase platform features are useful
Self-hosted or another managed PostgreSQL provider is selected

databaseAccessOptions.when: Type-safe SQL-oriented ORM/query builder is useful
The project already uses Prisma or its data model fits the project
Direct PostgreSQL access is simpler or existing architecture already uses it
Provider SDK or another existing access layer is already authoritative

cloud.when: Deploying Next.js or using Vercel Preview/Functions
Durable background workflows, retries, waits, or concurrency controls are required
A shared or production project benefits from remote verification on push/PR
Production errors, traces, and runtime health need visibility
